name: wfr
description: Read-only access to your own Wealthfront balances, activity and statements, through the open-source wfr CLI.
long_description: Ask Claude about your Wealthfront accounts: what each one is worth and their total, what moved in or out over a period (deposits, withdrawals, interest), and which statements and trade confirmations exist. Three read-only tools, wealthfront_accounts, wealthfront_activity and wealthfront_documents; nothing can trade, transfer or change your account. The extension asks for no password: Wealthfront sign-in is through a browser, so first install the wfr CLI and run `wfr auth login --browser` in a terminal. That stores the session in your OS keychain, and the bundled wfr reads it from there and keeps it current. On macOS the first call asks for keychain access; choose Always Allow. Unofficial; not affiliated with Wealthfront.

tools.name: wealthfront_accounts
tools.description: Each account's current value, and their total.

tools.name: wealthfront_activity
tools.description: Transactions over a date range: deposits, withdrawals, interest and fees.

tools.name: wealthfront_documents
tools.description: Statements and trade confirmations on file (listed, not downloaded).
